description: This Java source file defines the ClassConverter class, which provides methods for rewriting Java class files to different versions, converting between JDK version strings and class file versions, and validating class files.

classes.name: ClassConverter
classes.description: Provides static methods for converting Java class files between different versions, validating class files, and handling JDK version conversions.

methods.name: rewriteClass
methods.description: Rewrites a class byte array to be compatible with the current JDK version.

methods.name: rewriteClass
methods.description: Rewrites a class byte array to a specified maximum and minimum class file version.

methods.name: jdkToClassVersion
methods.description: Converts a JDK version string (e.g., '1.6.0_65') to a class file version number (e.g., 50).

methods.name: classVersionToJdk
methods.description: Converts a class file version number to a JDK version string.

methods.name: findHighestMajorVersion
methods.description: Finds the highest class file version among a collection of exceptions.

methods.name: getCurrentJdkVersion
methods.description: Returns the current JDK version as a string.

methods.name: getCurrentClassVersion
methods.description: Returns the class file version number of the current JDK.

methods.name: isValidClassFile
methods.description: Checks if the given byte array represents a valid Java class file.

methods.name: getMagic
methods.description: Returns the magic number of a class file, used to verify validity.

methods.name: getMajorVersion
methods.description: Returns the major version number from a class file byte array.

methods.name: getMinorVersion
methods.description: Returns the minor version number from a class file byte array.
